visualCharacteristics: Interactive testimonial switcher: a large active panel showing a person's photo alongside their name, role and quote, with a row of avatar tab buttons (name + role) below that switch the active testimonial.
contentPattern: One row per testimonial with two cells: cell 1 is the tab label (avatar image, name, role), cell 2 is the panel content (large photo, name, role, quote).
usage: Rotating customer/testimonial quotes selectable via an avatar tab menu.
